title: Extend the existing FastAPI service with a stateless random-letter generator. A client action such as clicking a Generat
report: Verified the implemented FastAPI app preserves POST /generate and adds public GET /generate-letter. The route returns GeneratedLetter using standard-library random.choice over A-Z, and tests/test_main.py imports app.main.app and validates HTTP 200, exactly one letter field, and the uppercase one-character domain. tests-artifacts/test_results.json contains individually observed PASS/200 rows for both existing POST /generate and new GET /generate-letter. Harness logs show python -m pytest genuinely ran with 4 passed (not zero tests) and a live Uvicorn GET /generate-letter received HTTP 200.
